specificationName: Instance-Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities

changesApplied.changeMade: Added new MCP tool that forwards activity data to rpc-api /v2/activities endpoint with (api_key, project_id) scoping
changesApplied.reason: Completes vessel flow for Activity.save() - enables cross-instance activity storage. Without this tool, activities are stuck in local storage and cannot be accessed from other instances.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - new tool addition, no existing code changes. Opencode Activity.save() already calls this tool gracefully (checks if tool exists before calling). Enables distributed debugging and activity replay from any instance.
changesApplied.vesselFlow: opencode Activity.save() -> this tool -> rpc-api /v2/activities -> SurrealDB

changesApplied.changeMade: Added new MCP tool that retrieves activity data from rpc-api /v2/activities/{id} endpoint with (api_key, project_id) scoping
changesApplied.reason: Completes vessel flow for Activity.load() - enables cross-instance activity retrieval. Without this tool, Instance A cannot load activities created by Instance B, breaking distributed workflows.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - new tool addition, no existing code changes. Opencode Activity.load() already calls this tool as fallback when local storage fails. Critical for activity replay and debugging across instances.
changesApplied.vesselFlow: opencode Activity.load() -> this tool -> rpc-api /v2/activities/{id} -> SurrealDB

changesApplied.changeMade: ALREADY ENFORCED - Backend sync via metabob_impulse_store() is implemented (lines 71-110)
changesApplied.reason: Enforces vessel flow: opencode -> CLI MCP -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB. Enables cross-instance impulse access. Impulses created in Instance A are accessible from Instance B with matching (api_key, project_id).
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero changes required - enforcement already complete. Tool gracefully handles missing MCP client and logs warnings. Non-blocking for local-only workflows.
changesApplied.vesselFlow: impulse_create tool -> metabob_impulse_store (CLI MCP) -> rpc-api /v2/impulses -> SurrealDB

changesApplied.changeMade: ALREADY ENFORCED - Backend sync via metabob_activity_save() is implemented (lines 664-710)
changesApplied.reason: Enforces vessel flow for activity persistence. Activities are saved to local storage (cache) AND backend (source of truth). Enables cross-instance activity access and distributed debugging.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero changes required - enforcement already complete. Tool existence check prevents errors when CLI tool not deployed. Non-blocking for local-only workflows.

changesApplied.changeMade: ALREADY ENFORCED - Backend fallback via metabob_activity_load() is implemented (lines 488-565)
changesApplied.reason: Enables cross-instance activity retrieval. When local storage fails, falls back to backend via CLI MCP. Critical for distributed debugging - Instance A can load activities created by Instance B.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero changes required - enforcement already complete. Try-catch ensures local storage is fast path, backend is fallback. Graceful degradation when MCP client unavailable.
changesApplied.vesselFlow: Activity.load() -> local storage (fast path) -> metabob_activity_load (fallback) -> rpc-api /v2/activities/{id} -> SurrealDB

dataFlowUpdates.after: impulse_create -> SessionMemory -> Activity.impulses -> Storage.write (cache) + metabob_impulse_store (CLI MCP) -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
dataFlowUpdates.impact: Impulses now accessible cross-instance. No breaking changes - backward compatible.

dataFlowUpdates.after: Activity.save() -> Storage.write (cache) + metabob_activity_save (CLI MCP) -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
dataFlowUpdates.impact: Activities now accessible cross-instance. Dual-write pattern maintains performance while adding persistence.

dataFlowUpdates.before: Activity.load() -> Storage.read(['activity', id]) (local only, fails for remote activities)
dataFlowUpdates.after: Activity.load() -> Storage.read (fast path) OR metabob_activity_load (fallback for cross-instance)
dataFlowUpdates.impact: Can now load activities created by other instances. Enables distributed debugging and activity replay.
